evidence.title: Florida judge allows lawsuit against Shah of Iran’s alleged ‘chief torturer’ to move forward

occurrences.checkable_against: Parviz Sabeti TVPA complaint and Savak historical records
occurrences.quote_span: Parviz Sabeti, who was reported last year to have lived in a quiet upscale central Florida community, is accused of being the former head of Savak, the shah’s secret police and intelligence agency.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Parviz Sabeti TVPA complaint
occurrences.quote_span: According to the complaint, he was “widely recognized as one of the most powerful and feared men in the shah’s regime … with the authority to apprehend, interrogate and prosecute opponents throughout the country”.
occurrences.speaker: the complaint
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Parviz Sabeti TVPA complaint and plaintiffs' sworn filings
occurrences.quote_span: They say they were abducted by Savak in Tehran, beaten into giving false confessions and served prison time.
occurrences.speaker: the plaintiffs
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Parviz Sabeti TVPA complaint and plaintiffs' sworn filings
occurrences.quote_span: The plaintiffs, Iranian men living in California aged 68 to 85, claim they were among thousands of people rounded up as perceived opponents of the shah by Savak, Iran’s notoriously brutal internal security and intelligence agency, and subjected to abuses at Sabeti’s personal direction.
occurrences.speaker: the plaintiffs
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaintiffs' May 2026 response filed in the Florida federal court docket
occurrences.quote_span: In May, attorneys for the three Iranian plaintiffs filed a response presenting dozens of documents and articles of their own to try to bolster their argument that there were extraordinary circumstances in the case that warranted an extension of time to bring the claim.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Parviz Sabeti TVPA complaint and future Florida federal court proceedings
occurrences.quote_span: He could now be made to answer as early as next year to civil claims under the Torture Victim Protection Act (TVPA) that he directed and took part in the detention and torture of thousands of the shah’s political opponents in jails in Tehran and elsewhere until the Islamic revolution swept the regime from power in 1979.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Claret Vargas's statement and Florida federal court docket
occurrences.quote_span: Claret Vargas, senior staff attorney for the Center for Justice and Accountability, an advocacy group representing the three Iranian plaintiffs, welcomed Presnell’s ruling, which she said allows the case to move forward towards discovery on the TVPA allegations against Sabeti.
occurrences.speaker: Claret Vargas
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Sabeti's prior public statements and court filings
occurrences.quote_span: Sabeti has previously insisted he was not involved in the detention, torture or execution of prisoners.
occurrences.speaker: Parviz Sabeti
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Gregory A. Presnell's sealed order and Florida federal court docket
occurrences.quote_span: Tuesday’s sealed order by the district court judge Gregory A Presnell rejected Sabeti’s argument that a statute of limitations on the allegations should be strictly enforced and a summary judgment issued in his favor.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Parviz Sabeti TVPA complaint and The Guardian's September 2025 article
occurrences.quote_span: They included the Guardian’s September 2025 story that chronicled Sabeti’s departure from Iran and his low-profile new life in Florida, where the lawsuit asserts he “has spent the last four decades out of the public eye, concealing his whereabouts and identity”.
occurrences.speaker: the lawsuit
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Florida federal court docket and prior court orders
occurrences.quote_span: The court previously dismissed the state law claims.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Florida federal court docket and order in the Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit
occurrences.quote_span: The alleged “chief torturer” for the deposed Shah of Iran is a step closer to trial for human rights abuses after a Florida federal judge rejected his demand to halt a lawsuit brought by three former political prisoners.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Parviz Sabeti TVPA complaint and historical records concerning the Apollo torture device
occurrences.quote_span: The lawsuit details the alleged use of a torture device nicknamed Apollo, an electric chair named after the early US space program, which featured a metal helmet that amplified victims’ screams into their own ears.
occurrences.speaker: the lawsuit
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: CIA 1978 analysis and its 2018 declassification/release record
occurrences.quote_span: As the Guardian reported last year, Sabeti was identified as a fiercely loyal ally of the shah, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, in a secret analysis by the US Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) written in 1978, which was not released until 2018.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Claret Vargas's statement and Presnell's ruling
occurrences.quote_span: “We don’t yet know the specific legal basis for the court’s decision, but it’s a really important milestone for our clients to be able to bring forth this case and really address [their allegations].”
occurrences.speaker: Claret Vargas
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Sabeti's court filings and cited public statements
occurrences.quote_span: Sabeti has denied allegations that that he was personally involved or that Savak tortured detainees, and claimed that he “always opposed torture”.
occurrences.speaker: Parviz Sabeti
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Guardian's contemporaneous request-for-comment records and Florida federal court filings
occurrences.quote_span: None replied to the Guardian’s request for comment by the time of publication.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Sabeti defense filings and attached property records, media articles and photograph
occurrences.quote_span: Sabeti’s lawyers dispute that he was difficult to find and sue before 2023, filing dozens of documents which they said proved he had lived openly in Florida under his real name, including property records, media articles, and a photograph of Sabeti with George HW Bush and his son Jeb Bush, a former governor of Florida.
occurrences.speaker: Sabeti's lawyers
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Parviz Sabeti TVPA complaint
occurrences.quote_span: Among their claims made under the TVPA are that their captors used rape, electric shocks, near-drownings and forced nail extraction against political prisoners.
occurrences.speaker: the plaintiffs
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Florida federal court docket and attorney appearance filings
occurrences.quote_span: Court papers list seven attorneys for Sabeti.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023 People’s Mojahedin Organization of Iran report and Sabeti's Manoto interview
occurrences.quote_span: A 2023 report on the website of the People’s Mojahedin Organization of Iran, a dissident group, cited an interview Sabeti gave to the Persian channel Manoto in which he characterized his government employment as clerical work.
occurrences.speaker: People’s Mojahedin Organization of Iran report
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaintiffs' court filings and the daughter's social-media post
occurrences.quote_span: The plaintiffs say they discovered his whereabouts only after a photo of Sabeti at a 2023 protest against the Iranian government was posted on social media by his daughter.
occurrences.speaker: the plaintiffs
occurrences.subject: Parviz Sabeti TVPA lawsuit
